svg.title: One variable. Opposite directions.
svg.desc: Presentation-only design sketch. All trend colours, traces, results and dates of change are illustrative, not NASA observations. Coastline: Natural Earth.
svg.text: DESIGN STUDY / ILLUSTRATIVE DATA / NOT A LIVE ANALYSIS
REFINEMENT 02 / SIGNAL DESK / PROPOSAL FOR TEAM REVIEW
Make a two-place reading of the same prepared layer visible, with signs as well as colour.
Map estimates, not the custom time window.
Pin up to two available map cells. Never invent an opposite sign or replace the selected place.
No second analysis endpoint · two map-cell readouts only · labels and +/− signs carry meaning without colour.
